ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.

19. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

20. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.

22. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Our ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
